headline: India evacuates tens of thousands as Cyclone Arnab nears the Andhra Pradesh coast
headline_es: India evacúa a decenas de miles ante la llegada del ciclón Arnab a Andhra Pradesh
caption_en: Cyclone Arnab has strengthened into a very severe cyclonic storm over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to make landfall on India's Andhra Pradesh coast early Wednesday, according to the India Meteorological Department. Authorities in Andhra Pradesh and neighbouring Odisha have moved tens of thousands of people from low-lying areas to cyclone shelters. Flights and trains have been cancelled as heavy rain and strong winds are forecast.
caption_es: El ciclón Arnab se intensificó hasta convertirse en una tormenta ciclónica muy severa sobre el golfo de Bengala y se espera que toque tierra en la costa de Andhra Pradesh, India, la madrugada del miércoles, según el Departamento Meteorológico de India. Las autoridades de Andhra Pradesh y del vecino Odisha trasladaron a decenas de miles de personas de zonas bajas a refugios. Se cancelaron vuelos y trenes ante el pronóstico de lluvias intensas y fuertes vientos.
summary_es: Andhra Pradesh y Odisha trasladaron a decenas de miles de personas a refugios antes de la llegada a tierra prevista para el miércoles.
summary_en: Andhra Pradesh and Odisha moved tens of thousands of people to shelters ahead of the expected Wednesday landfall.
